tariffSource.source: official Powy FAQ retained in run161
tariffSource.caveat: session/app price overrides base grid if a station-specific variation or offer is explicitly shown

replay.classificationRule: derive AC/DC from connector.powerType; derive class from connector.maxPowerKw; fail closed when no official class exists or fields conflict
replay.note: The historical artifact was downloaded and audited before expiry in run162. Future replay should regenerate the candidate from the workflow/source data if row-level IDs are needed again.

notes: No tariff was extrapolated to AC EVSE above 22 kW because the official grid does not define that class.
All 1077 covered rows have deterministic AC/DC current type and maxPowerKw in the retained PUN-derived candidate artifact.
Three anomalous rows remain fail-closed: one AC Type2 row at 32 kW and two rows marked AC_3_PHASE while using CCS2 at 50 kW.
